recs.title: Your 10 recommended actions
items: Send the weekly newsletter: the 12 Oct draft is ready and you asked Zein to confirm the listing/RFP picks. Once he confirms, send it and delete the 28 Sep and 5 Oct drafts.
Post the "If you have it, we buy it" set below. Eight live requests have 0 offers, and #443 TS15 expires Sat 17 Oct.
Post 1–2 "sold" success stories (below). They're our strongest proof of completed deals.
Topcon week: 5 new Topcon HiPer SR/VR kits were listed on 6 Oct. Do one carousel post on FB, IG and LinkedIn.
Add UTM tags to every social and newsletter link so GA4 can attribute leads. Conversions are 0 and nothing in Odoo is source-tagged.
Digital Realities: post one Matterport Pro3 use-case on FR channels this week. Stock is 3 cameras + 6 kits, and the GA4 traffic there is near zero.
WhatsApp broadcast copy (11 Oct): Claude asked whether it's OK to share. Get Zein's yes, then remind the reps.
LinkedIn: follow up the INTERGEO connections with a "thanks for visiting + 5% off" reminder post before the offer goes stale.
Ask Zein whether to restart Google Ads once billing is fixed. Keep only the campaigns that converted (see the dashboard's Ads vs Results section).
Inbox items for you (Inbox Log, marketing): the Drone Show Korea 2027 promotion and the Bourdin Business podcast invite (Zein to decide). The rest is vendor newsletters, no action.
